firstPlayerRule: The player who looks most like a mobster takes the Capo Ring and starts. If the players cannot agree, the first to say an accurate quote from a gangster movie starts.
clarifications: Initial Influence Markers are placed clockwise, beginning with the Capo Ring holder.
